name: Radar Chart
description: SVG radar (spider) chart that overlays multi-series polygons across a shared set of axes.
usage:
<RadarChart
  aria-label="Skill profiles"
  axes={["Frontend", "Backend", "Testing", "DevOps"]}
  series={[{ name: "Ada", values: [5, 3, 4, 2] }]}
/>

anatomy.description: Spokes from the center, one per dimension, starting at the top and going clockwise.
Concentric polygons marking scale steps up to the shared max.
Translucent filled outline per series with a native title tooltip of its values.
Dimension names placed just outside each spoke.

dos: Keep axes commensurable (same units or normalized scores) and pass max explicitly.
Stay at three to eight axes; labels collide beyond that.
Limit it to two or three series; overlapping fills get muddy fast.
donts: Don't use it for precise value reading; use DataTable.
Don't mix unnormalized units like revenue with percentages on one chart.
Don't use it for time series; use LineChart.

examples.title: Multi-series comparison
examples.description: Two overlapping polygons make relative strengths across axes easy to compare.

examples.title: Single profile with fixed scale
examples.description: One series against an explicit max with a ring per scale step.

guidance.useWhen: You compare multivariate profiles, such as skill matrices or product trade-offs, on a shared scale.
guidance.avoidWhen: Axes are not commensurable or you need precise value reading; use a DataTable or Stat list instead.
guidance.behavior: Purely presentational: values scale to the shared max (or the data max), each series polygon carries a native title tooltip, and an sr-only summary lists every value.
guidance.responsive: Renders as a fixed-size square; shrink the size prop at narrow viewports.

notes: The chart is a single role="img" with an aria-label; a visually hidden summary lists each series with per-axis values.
Series colors pair with named tooltips so overlapping polygons remain distinguishable without color.

props.description: Accessible description of the chart, applied as aria-label.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Axis names, one per spoke, starting at the top and going clockwise.
props.name: axes

props.description: Scale maximum; defaults to the largest value across all series.
props.name: max
